title: National Electrical Code Of India 2023
scope: This national electrical code provides comprehensive guidelines for planning, design, installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems. It covers power systems, distribution boards, earthing, protection relays, surge protection, and energy metering. Applicable to all electrical installations in India governed by regulatory authorities.
semantic_text: SP 30:2023: National Electrical Code Of India 2023. Scope: This national electrical code provides comprehensive guidelines for planning, design, installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems. It covers power systems, distribution boards, earthing, protection relays, surge protection, and energy metering. Applicable to all electrical installations in India governed by regulatory authorities. Normative references: IS 732, IS 3043, IS 1646. Domain keywords: National, Electrical, Code, India, 2023, This. No mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) currently notified for this standard. Certification is voluntary unless specified in tender documents. Standard status: Active (current version).

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: This standard provides the code of practice for electrical wiring installations in buildings and structures. It covers design principles, selection and erection of electrical equipment, protection against overcurrent and electric shock, earthing arrangements, and testing requirements. Applicable to low-voltage installations in residential, commercial, and industrial premises.
semantic_text: IS 732:2019: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations. Scope: This standard provides the code of practice for electrical wiring installations in buildings and structures. It covers design principles, selection and erection of electrical equipment, protection against overcurrent and electric shock, earthing arrangements, and testing requirements. Applicable to low-voltage installations in residential, commercial, and industrial premises. Normative references: SP 30, IS 3043, IS 694. Domain keywords: Code, Practice, Electrical, Wiring, Installations, Fourth. Mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) certification required. Gazette notification S.O. 5147(E) issued by Ministry of Power, effective from 2024-01-01. Certification scheme: BIS ISI Mark (CM/L number) mandatory for all units manufactured or imported. Products requiring certification: wiring harness, cable trays, conduit systems, junction boxes. Mandate: All electrical wiring installations in commercial and residential buildings shall conform to IS 732:2019 and carry mandatory BIS ISI Mark (CM/L number). Non-compliant installations shall be prohibited from use in government-funded procurement. Standard status: Active (current version).

title: Medical Electrical Equipment - Part 1 General Requirements for Basic Safety and Essential Performance
scope: This standard specifies general requirements for basic safety and essential performance of medical electrical equipment intended for use in medical diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment. It covers electrical insulation, creepage and clearance distances, mechanical strength, thermal limits, and protection against electrical shock. Applicable to equipment operated under professional supervision in hospitals, clinics, and home healthcare environments.
semantic_text: IS 13450 : Part 1:2024: Medical Electrical Equipment - Part 1 General Requirements for Basic Safety and Essential Performance. Scope: This standard specifies general requirements for basic safety and essential performance of medical electrical equipment intended for use in medical diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment. It covers electrical insulation, creepage and clearance distances, mechanical strength, thermal limits, and protection against electrical shock. Applicable to equipment operated under professional supervision in hospitals, clinics, and home healthcare environments. Normative references: IEC 60601-1, IS 13450 : Part 1-2, IS 1778. Domain keywords: Medical, Electrical, Equipment, Basic, Safety, Essential. Mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) certification required. Gazette notification S.O. 2321(E) issued by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, effective from 2022-10-01. Certification scheme: BIS ISI Mark (CM/L number) mandatory for all units manufactured or imported. Products requiring certification: patient monitors, defibrillators, ventilators, infusion pumps, diagnostic imaging equipment. Mandate: Medical electrical equipment imported or manufactured in India must comply with IS 13450:2024 (Part 1) for basic safety and essential performance. Mandatory BIS ISI certification required before commercial sale or procurement by government hospitals. Standard status: Active (current version).

title: Luminaries Performance Part 2 Particular Requirements Section 2 LED Street Lighting
scope: This standard specifies photometric, electrical, and mechanical performance requirements for LED luminaires used in public street and road lighting. It covers luminous flux, luminous efficacy, colour rendering index (CRI), correlated colour temperature (CCT), ingress protection, surge immunity, thermal management, and lifetime ratings. Intended for use in municipal, highway, and smart city lighting projects.
semantic_text: IS 16107 : Part 2 : Sec 2:2017: Luminaries Performance Part 2 Particular Requirements Section 2 LED Street Lighting. Scope: This standard specifies photometric, electrical, and mechanical performance requirements for LED luminaires used in public street and road lighting. It covers luminous flux, luminous efficacy, colour rendering index (CRI), correlated colour temperature (CCT), ingress protection, surge immunity, thermal management, and lifetime ratings. Intended for use in municipal, highway, and smart city lighting projects. Normative references: IS 10322, IS 15885, IEC 62722-2-1. Domain keywords: LED, Street, Lighting, Performance. Mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) certification required. Gazette notification S.O. 4419(E) issued by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), effective from 2021-12-01. Certification scheme: BIS ISI Mark (CM/L number) mandatory for all units manufactured or imported. Products requiring certification: LED street lights, LED flood lights, LED high mast lights. Mandate: LED street lighting luminaires procured by municipal bodies, PWD, and smart city projects must mandatorily carry the BIS ISI Mark under IS 16107 (Part 2/Sec 2):2017. Procurement of non-certified luminaires is prohibited. Standard status: Active (current version).
